summary: Comprehensive testing of GPS Mileage Tracker unified quick trip system and Siri API key feature. Backend: 14/14 tests passed (100%) - Siri API key CRUD (generate, status, revoke), Siri key authentication for log-drive endpoint, JWT authentication for log-drive, edge cases (duplicate start, end without active trip), invalid/revoked key rejection. Frontend: All UI elements verified - Start Trip header button (green, data-testid='start-trip-header-btn'), GPS Mileage Tracker section, Quick Trip section with Start Trip button, Siri Shortcuts guide with Generate API Key button, Manual Entry button, Summary tabs (Today/Month/Year).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend get_admin_or_siri_user dependency correctly handles both JWT and Siri API key authentication
Siri API key is hashed with SHA256 before storage - only key_prefix is stored for display
log-drive endpoint properly handles start/end events with OSRM road routing and Nominatim geocoding
Frontend GPSMileageTracker exposes startTrip/endTrip methods via ref for header button delegation
Siri Shortcuts guide provides clear step-by-step instructions for iPhone Shortcuts setup
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: Test trips created during backend testing (cleaned up via teardown)
context_for_next_testing_agent: GPS Mileage Tracker unified system fully tested. KEY FEATURES: (1) Unified quick trip system using log-drive endpoint with event=start/end. (2) Siri API key management - POST /api/admin/gps-trips/siri-key generates key, GET returns status (has_key, key_prefix), DELETE revokes. (3) log-drive accepts both JWT and Siri API key auth via get_admin_or_siri_user dependency. (4) Header green Start Trip button delegates to GPSMileageTracker ref.startTrip(). Frontend data-testids: start-trip-header-btn, end-trip-header-btn, gps-mileage-tracker, quick-trip-section, start-trip-btn, end-trip-btn, siri-shortcuts-guide, generate-siri-key-btn, revoke-siri-key-btn, manual-entry-btn, summary-tab-today, summary-tab-month, summary-tab-year.
